_comment: Recommended libraries & tools directory (Ctrl+B). Loaded by src/libraries.js and merged with an optional config/libraries.local.json (gitignored) - a local category with the same title REPLACES the base one. Category titles are localized { pl, en }; item descriptions are plain strings, i.e. language-neutral: they are technical blurbs, not UI chrome. Item ids are DERIVED from the name by the loader - do not write them here. `url` must be http(s). The renderer never hands an address back to the main process; it names an id and main resolves the URL from this file.

items.name: daisyUI
items.description: Tailwind plugin that turns utility soup into semantic class names (btn, card, modal). Pure CSS - no JS runtime - and themes swap via a data attribute.

items.name: Kokonut UI
items.description: Copy-paste React components on Tailwind and Motion. The source ships with the component, so an agent edits it instead of fighting a package API.

items.name: OriginKit
items.description: React blocks at the layout level - sections, shells, page scaffolds - rather than individual controls.

items.name: Motion
items.description: Animation for React and plain JS built on the browser's own animation engine. Successor to Framer Motion: hardware-accelerated transforms, no JS render loop.

items.name: Particles (Casberry)
items.description: Configurable particle-field backgrounds on Canvas/WebGL. Decorative - check the frame cost before putting one behind live content.

items.name: Bklit UI
items.description: Chart and telemetry components aimed at dashboards that update while you watch them, rather than static reports.

items.name: Manus
items.description: Hosted agent that drives a browser and runs multi-step tasks on its own. Closed and cloud-side: you hand it a goal, not a tool loop you control.

items.name: cloudflare/computer
items.description: Gives an agent a POSIX-ish filesystem inside a Durable Object, so a sandbox keeps its working state between calls instead of starting cold every time.

items.name: usestrix/strix
items.description: Agents that pentest an app from inside a Docker sandbox and try to prove each finding with a working PoC - the part that separates it from a scanner emitting maybes.

items.name: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.description: Pulls the last 30 days from X, Reddit, YouTube, HN and Polymarket into one summary. Already installed in this setup - see the /last30days command.

items.name: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.description: Editorial HTML/SVG diagram templates for coding agents - flywheels, system maps, sequences. The pitch is escaping default Mermaid output. Also installed here.

items.name: tt-a1i/archify
items.description: Parses a codebase into a typed JSON intermediate form, then compiles a self-contained interactive architecture map whose nodes link back to the commit behind them.

items.name: unclecode/crawl4ai
items.description: Crawler whose output target is a context window, not a browser: clean Markdown plus structured extraction, page chrome already stripped.

items.name: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.description: CLI that searches Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu without paid API keys. It scrapes rather than calls APIs, so expect breakage when a site changes.

items.name: browser-use/browser-use
items.description: Lets an agent work a real web UI from both the DOM tree and screenshots, which is what gets it through flows a selector-only script would lose.

items.name: AKCodez/seo-god
items.description: SEO agent that audits a site, tracks keyword positions and AI-answer visibility, and can run the fix loop on a schedule instead of on request.

items.name: JCodesMore/ai-website-cloner-template
items.description: Reads an existing site's computed CSS, assets and layout and rebuilds it as a Next.js/Tailwind project. Fine for porting your own old site; check the licence otherwise.

items.name: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
items.description: One endpoint in front of OpenAI, Anthropic and local models, handling fallback and rate limits so the choice of backend stops leaking into app code.

items.name: jamiepine/voicebox
items.description: Voice synthesis and cloning on local TTS models, with a multi-track timeline, dictation and an MCP surface so an agent can speak and listen.

items.name: guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover
items.description: Strips C2PA provenance metadata and synthetic watermarks from text and media. Note what that means - it removes AI-origin signals, so think about where the output goes.

items.name: pranshuparmar/witr
items.description: Answers "why is this running?" on Linux - walks PID ancestry, the systemd/Docker/PM2 supervisor above a process and the ports below it, and prints the causal chain.

items.name: vitali87/code-graph-rag
items.description: Tree-sitter parse into a Memgraph knowledge graph you can query in natural language. Same idea as the codebase-memory MCP already wired into this setup.

items.name: public-apis/public-apis
items.description: The long-running index of free public APIs by category. A starting point - entries go stale and auth requirements drift.

items.name: livekit/agents
items.description: Voice agents as WebRTC participants: the STT-LLM-TTS loop plus the interruption and turn-taking handling that makes real-time speech bearable.

items.name: langflow-ai/langflow
items.description: Node-graph editor for agent workflows with Python custom nodes and MCP/API export. The visual layer earns its keep when handing a flow to someone else.

items.name: langgenius/dify
items.description: Self-hostable LLMOps platform covering workflows, RAG, agents and prompt iteration - heavier than a library, lighter than building the ops layer yourself.

items.name: xiamuceer-j/MuMuAINovel
items.description: Long-form fiction drafting that keeps the state a novel needs - characters, plot timeline, relationship graph - outside the context window.

items.name: GVCLab/PersonaLive
items.description: Streaming diffusion for continuous portrait animation, targeted at a single 12GB GPU - the constraint that decides whether it runs on your machine.

items.name: aiming-lab/AutoResearchClaw
items.description: A 23-stage research pipeline: literature search, experiment runs, self-healing code, review and LaTeX. Wide scope - treat the output as a draft under review.

items.name: Zackriya-Solutions/meetily
items.description: Meeting notes with nothing leaving the machine: Rust/Tauri app, live transcription, speaker diarization, Ollama summaries.

items.name: coollabsio/coolify
items.description: Self-hosted deploy layer for apps, databases and Docker services on a VPS you own - the usual answer to a Vercel bill that stopped being small.

items.name: CoreBunch/Instatic
items.description: Git-backed visual CMS on Bun: content modeling and canvas layout editing that commit to the repo, then build a static site.

items.name: Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF
items.description: Self-hosted PDF toolbox - merge, split, convert, OCR - so documents stop going through a random web converter.
